chunks: ‘Ali ibn al-Ḥusayn narrated to me from Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Īsā, from ‘Ali ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashyam, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, who said:

I asked Imam al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) about the visitation (Ziyārah) of the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him): ‘What is its virtue/reward?’ He (peace be upon him) said, ‘It is equal to an ‘Umrah.’

key_terms.زِيَارَة: Visitation (Ziyarah), specifically visiting the graves of Imams or prophets

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Riḍā (a.s.) establishes the profound spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn’s (a.s.) shrine by equating it to the reward of an ‘Umrah, a status that underscores the sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia piety. This comparison highlights that while ‘Umrah is a mandatory act of worship, the Ziyarah of the Imams carries a comparable, if not superior, weight of devotion and intercession, reinforcing the theological link between the Prophet’s household and the path to divine forgiveness.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Ali ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashyam, from Safwān ibn Yaḥyā, who said:
I asked Imam Riďā (a.s.), “What it the reward for going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) said, “It is equal to performing an ‘Umrah.”
